8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Single Channel Wireless Headband Microphone with Trans Receiver (2 Nos.) A wireless headband microphone and receiver set is ideal for teaching purpose, as it allows hands-free mo vement and lets you walk freely around the classroom. Headband Microphone: A lightweight mic that fits securely over the head or around the ears. Transmitter: The unit that sends audio signals wirelessly from the mic to the receiver. It usually comes as a body pack worn on a belt or pocket, or as a compact unit integrated directly into the headset frame. Receiver: The unit that receives the signal from the transmitter and plugs directly into the PA system. Technical Specifications (Single channel) Transmission Type: 2.4 GHz Digital: Best for standard classrooms (30–50 students). Easy auto-pairing (si milar to Bluetooth) with clean sound and minimal interference. UHF (Ultra High Frequency): Better for larger halls or auditoriums. Provides wider operating range and penetrates obstacles more reliably. Operating Range: 15 to 30 meters (50–100 feet), which provides plenty of coverage to move around any standard classroom without dropouts. Microphone: Unidirectional /Cardioid: Recommended over omnidirectional mics because it picks up soun d Transmitter Power: Built-in rechargeable (Lithium-ion batteries) or removable type * primarily from the mouth, minimizing background student chatter and room echo. * Battery Performance: Minimum 5 to 8 hours of continuous operation per charge. * Accessories: Compatible charging unit and power adapter must be supplied with the device. Receiver: Power supply direct 230volt or DC Adapter type Audio Output & Connectivity: The receiver typically features a 3.5 mm (1/8") plug along with a 6.35 m m (1/4") adapter, making it plug-and-play with PA systems. Plug and Play: Look for devices with automatic pairing (turns on and connects instantly without manual f requency tuning). . 9.
